profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with an eye for the details and a heart for customer success. Strong engineering professional skilled in Ruby, Integrations, Databases, Management, Software as a Service (SaaS), and Software Documentation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead top integration initiatives to connect PeopleAdmin’s applicant tracking system with a variety of customer HRIS systems.
•	Integrate with partner HRIS systems through RESTful API development.
•	SCRUM master managing product backlog, sprint commitments, and deployment operations.
•	Manage and mentor two junior engineers.
•	Manage partner and customer timelines / communications.
•	Contribute to architectural and product direction through both domain and product maintenance expertise.
•	Produce documentation and diagrams for both internal and external team consumption.
•	Onboard, mentor, and train additional team members both on and off shore.
•	Deliver documented solutions to Professional Services team and support through initial go-lives.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led new feature development of an Internal Job Board enabling employee access to internal jobs.
•	Innovation Week Winner for enabling customer self-service of business logic triggers.
•	Successfully on boarded/mentored both onshore and offshore maintenance engineers.
•	Instrumental in retaining quality of core products with minimal regression through Code Review process.
•	Prepared and supported production deployments.
•	Experience in both Scrum and Kanban Agile Methodologies.

positions.title: Escalations Engineer
positions.description:
•	Reduced the bug backlog by 50%.
•	Delivered high-quality, well-tested bug fixes and feature enhancements.
•	Work impact totaling $6.5 million this year in ARR
•	Led company-wide demonstrations.

positions.title: Education Consultant
positions.description:
•	Developed courseware for professional services training offerings.
•	Delivered custom training for customer-specific processes.
•	Scripted, recorded, and produced role-specific videos on fundamental processes and features.
•	Scripted and conducted a live, customer-facing webinar series for each major product release.
•	Participated in the quality assurance testing for each major product release.
•	Developed, maintained, and delivered product training for new employees.

positions.title: Lead Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Joined as Consultant, promoted rapidly through a series of increasingly responsible technical positions based on strong quality of delivery and team leadership performance. Developed a track record for managing projects through successful maintenance mode.

•	Coordinated development and testing for the integration between SunGard business unit’s existing CRM system and Salesforce.com
•	Developed Java services from detailed technical specifications to route, archive, and trace XML documents through the auto nominations application that enables near real-time transition of nomination and schedule data.
•	Developed data access objects and stored procedures to manage application data for Duke Energy.
•	Worked with the database administrator to tune the stored procedures for improved system performance.
•	Developed the user interface, complex fluid hydraulic calculation modules, triggers, and stored procedures for PULSE, an application that enables users on the drilling rig to access mud-logging data and monitor drilling activity in near real time
•	Developed the user interface for an energy arbitrage trading application that provided programmatic deal execution and notification of arbitrage opportunities to traders.
•	Led and mentored maintenance engineers through system enhancements and bug fixes for two production systems.
•	Managed system/user testing, deployments, and user training across multiple client projects.
•	Obtained Microsoft Certified Solution Developer certification to preserve company’s certification status and partnership.
•	Clients: SunGard Data Systems, Inc., British Petroleum, Shell Trading (U.S.), Duke Energy, Reliant Wholesale, Petrolog

educations.schoolName: Mays Business School - Texas A&M University
